# Context Mode — Native Google Antigravity Plugin **Native Google Antigravity plugin adaptation of [`mksglu/context-mode`](https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode) (Copyright 2026 Mert Koseoglu, licensed under [ELv2](LICENSE)) — a free, local plugin for 12 coding agents. Modified to add native Google Antigravity support while syncing automatically with upstream. It keeps tool output out of your agent's context window and keeps all usage data on your machine. The plugin is free forever.** [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/context-mode?label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/context-mode) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/mksglu/context-mode?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1478479412700909750?label=Discord&logo=discord&color=5865f2)](https://discord.gg/DCN9jUgN5v) [![License: ELv2](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ELv2-blue.svg)](LICENSE) **35K GitHub stars · 956K npm downloads** (read 2026-11-27, [stats.json](stats.json)) · on the Hacker News front page and GitHub Trending: [charts and sources](#adoption-stars-and-npm-downloads) > The Context Mode plugin is free and local, with its source open on GitHub. **Context Mode Gateway** is a separate hosted service with its own account and subscription. It takes the same idea from tool output to the whole conversation: Gateway Recall keeps long sessions searchable, and Gateway Memory shares what your agents learn across sessions and tools. [See how the Gateway works](https://contextmode.ai/docs/how-saving-works?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=quote) **Google Antigravity Native Adaptation (App · CLI `agy` · IDE)** — First-class native plugin adaptation synced automatically with upstream `mksglu/context-mode` via GitHub Actions. ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/calvinxxw/context-mode-antigravity ``` - **Native plugin & hooks:** `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`, `hooks.json` (`SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`), PascalCase tool normalization, and `/ctx-doctor`, `/ctx-stats`, `/ctx-upgrade` skills. - **Direct MCP hot path & workspace resolution:** 5 hot-path tools (`ctx_execute`, `ctx_batch`, `ctx_index`, `ctx_search`, `ctx_resume`) configured `eager: true`, 3-tier workspace & `conversationId` resolution (`roots/list` + hook handoff), `PreInvocation` deduplication, and Windows UTF-8/GB18030 sandbox decoding. - **Details:** [Antigravity Adaptation Guide](docs/architecture/antigravity-adaptation.md) · [Install & verify steps](#install-antigravity) **Contents:** [Why](#why) · [Adoption](#adoption-stars-and-npm-downloads) · [Install](#install) · [Try it](#try-it) · [Use cases](#use-cases) · [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Tools](#tools) · [Security and privacy](#security-and-privacy) · [Context Mode Gateway](#context-mode-gateway) · [License](#license) · [Community](#community) ## Why A coding agent reads files, runs commands and fetches pages, and every result goes into its context window. The Context Mode plugin runs that work in a local sandbox, keeps the full output in a SQLite index on your machine, and gives the agent the part it asks for. - **The plugin is free forever.** Use it at home and at work, free of charge, under a source-available license. - **Runs on your machine.** The hooks, the sandbox and search run as local processes next to your agent. - **The plugin keeps your data on your machine.** Every index lives in `~/.context-mode`: one `context.db` per project. - **Zero telemetry.** The plugin keeps all usage data on your machine. [Security and privacy](#security-and-privacy) lists each network call it makes. - **Works offline after install.** Sandbox runs, file indexing and search use local SQLite and your own runtimes. - **Code Mode.** The agent writes a short script instead of reading the data, and only what the script prints reaches the context: see [How it works, step 5](#code-mode). - **Small replies.** On the 36 bench rows with 10 KB or more of raw output, the plugin's median reply is 99.4% smaller than the raw output. ## Adoption: stars and npm downloads
Open the [interactive chart](https://contextmode.ai/open-source/stats?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=adoption#daily) and point at a bar to read its value. Tabs there show days, weeks, months and years. Stars come from the GitHub GraphQL API (`starredAt`); npm downloads come from `api.npmjs.org/downloads/range`. The total up to 2026-10-29 is 683K npm downloads (`stats.json` keeps a daily copy). A daily job redraws both charts. - **Hacker News.** "MCP server that reduces Claude Code context consumption by 98%" reached the front page with 570+ points and 107 comments on 2026-02-28 ([thread](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47193064)). - **GitHub Trending.** A bot that watches GitHub Trending logged the repo there on 14 days from 2026-04-24 to 2026-10-17 ([uibm/trending-watcher](https://github.com/uibm/trending-watcher/issues?q=%22mksglu%2Fcontext-mode%22)). Starred by engineers at these companies: each name is the company field of 2 or more stargazer profiles, read with the GitHub GraphQL API on 2026-11-01 ([data](docs/assets/readme/data/stargazer-companies.json)). ## Install Pick your agent: [Claude Code](#install-claude-code) · [Codex](#install-codex) · [Gemini CLI](#install-gemini) · [Qwen Code](#install-qwen) · [Pi](#install-pi) · [OMP](#install-omp) · [OpenCode](#install-opencode) · [Copilot CLI](#install-copilot-cli) · [Kiro](#install-kiro) · [VS Code](#install-vscode) · [ZCode](#install-zcode) · [Antigravity](#install-antigravity) Open its block and copy its own install command. Each block also holds the update, check and remove steps, and the [Install guide](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/install?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=install) walks through them. The plugin needs Node 24.15.0 or later, from the engines field in [package.json](package.json). On Windows, add Git for Windows: the shell tools run in Git Bash, and doctor checks for it. contextmode installs as the npm package and command `context-mode`. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Qwen Code install from GitHub, and each of their commands names the release branch.
Claude Code ```sh claude plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode claude plugin install context-mode@context-mode ``` ```sh # update claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode # check claude plugin list # remove claude plugin marketplace remove context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (package) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Codex ```sh codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode codex plugin add context-mode@context-mode # one-time step: trust the plugin hooks npm i -g context-mode context-mode setup --agents codex ``` ```sh # update codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode # check codex mcp list # remove codex plugin remove context-mode@context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Gemini CLI ```sh gemini extensions install https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode ``` ```sh # update gemini extensions update context-mode # check GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true gemini mcp list # remove gemini extensions uninstall context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (package) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Qwen Code ```sh qwen extensions install https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode:context-mode ``` ```sh # update qwen extensions update context-mode # check qwen extensions list # remove qwen extensions uninstall context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (package) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Pi ```sh pi install npm:context-mode ``` ```sh # update pi update --extensions # check pi list # remove pi remove npm:context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (the plugin's own event handlers) · MCP ✓ (ctx tools built into the plugin) · Skills ✓
OMP ```sh omp plugin install context-mode ``` ```sh # update omp plugin upgrade context-mode # check omp plugin list # remove omp plugin uninstall context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (the plugin's own event handlers) · MCP ✓ (ctx tools built into the plugin) · Skills ✓
OpenCode ```sh opencode plugin add context-mode ``` ```sh # update opencode plugin update # check opencode mcp list --pure # OpenCode 1.19 opencode mcp list --standalone # OpenCode 2 # remove opencode plugin remove context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (the plugin's own event handlers) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Copilot CLI ```sh npm i -g context-mode context-mode setup --agents copilot-cli ``` ```sh # update context-mode upgrade # check context-mode doctor --agents copilot-cli copilot mcp list # remove context-mode setup --remove --agents copilot-cli ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Kiro ```sh npm i -g context-mode context-mode setup --agents kiro ``` ```sh # update context-mode upgrade # check context-mode doctor --agents kiro # remove context-mode setup --remove --agents kiro ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
VS Code (Copilot) ```sh npm i -g context-mode context-mode setup --agents vscode ``` ```sh # update context-mode upgrade # check context-mode doctor --agents vscode # remove context-mode setup --remove --agents vscode ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
ZCode ```sh zcode plugins marketplace add mksglu/context-mode zcode plugins install context-mode@context-mode ``` ```sh # update zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode # check zcode plugins list # remove zcode plugins uninstall context-mode@context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
Antigravity ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/calvinxxw/context-mode-antigravity ``` ```sh # update context-mode upgrade # check agy plugin list # remove agy plugin uninstall context-mode ``` Hooks ✓ (hook file) · MCP ✓ · Skills ✓
The npm route works for every agent: ```sh npm i -g context-mode context-mode setup ``` Setup is also the repair. It shows a plan, saves your earlier config, then applies the plan; when a step ends early, it restores the saved config. To uninstall: ```sh context-mode setup --remove npm rm -g context-mode ``` Restart the agent, then run `/ctx-doctor` in it. Each check prints PASS or a fix command, and the [Doctor guide](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/doctor?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=install-doctor) explains each check.
How we tested the install Every agent gets hooks, the MCP server and the plugin skills; the last line of each block above says how. Hooks reach each agent in one of three ways: in the plugin package (Antigravity, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code), in a hook file (Codex, Copilot CLI, Kiro, VS Code, ZCode), or in a plugin inside the agent (OpenCode, Pi, OMP). The [Agents guide](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/agents?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=install-agents) shows what each agent runs. We ran the real binary of each agent with the plugin hook: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Pi, OpenCode, Copilot CLI and ZCode. Each run used a clean temp home and a local test model, on 2.0.0-next.15. OMP 18.20.0 ran the same way with ADR-0026, and CI installs the real OMP on Linux, macOS and Windows. For VS Code and Kiro, the check covers the hook setup: VS Code runs the hook command with the documented payload, and kiro-cli 2.35.2 loads all 6 hook entries. CI runs setup, doctor, a hook and an MCP handshake for all 12 agents from the packed package on Linux, macOS and Windows. Record: [HOOKS-FIRE.md](docs/architecture/release/HOOKS-FIRE.md). Each agent uses its own install command, and [ADR-0023](docs/architecture/adr/ADR-0023-native-install.md) says why.
Your first task with the plugin, step by step: [First session](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/first-session?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=install-next). Or paste a prompt from [Try it](#try-it) right now. ## Try it Paste one of these prompts into your agent after the install. Each one ran once, live, in Claude Code 2.1.312, and its answer matched the source data ([evidence and rerun steps](bench/evidence/try-it-2026-11-02/README.md)). The headline numbers in [Benchmarks](#benchmarks) use the median of 5 runs. Other agents do the same job with the same tools: `ctx_execute`, `ctx_index` and `ctx_search`. After a prompt, run the stats skill and read the report yourself ([See the saving](#see-the-saving)). ```text On https://react.dev/reference/react/useEffect, show me the example that connects to a chat server and cleans up, and list the rules for the dependency array. ``` The hook sends WebFetch to the sandbox, and the agent searches the page for the example and the rules. 601,984 B raw, 20,860 B reached the context, 96.5% saved (2026-11-02, 2.0.0-next.26, claude-haiku-5-5). ```text Fetch https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/photos. Which photo has the longest title (give its id and title), and how many photos have a title that contains the word "est"? ``` The agent runs code over 5,000 JSON records in the sandbox and gets back two answers. 1,039,898 B raw, 393 B reached the context, 99.96% saved (2026-11-02, 2.0.0-next.26, claude-haiku-5-5). The answer is two short facts, so this is the best case of the four. ```text Here is a Linux syslog sample: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/logpai/loghub/master/Linux/Linux_2k.log. How many authentication failures does it contain, and which 3 remote hosts caused the most? ``` The agent counts failures in a 1,999-line syslog in the sandbox. 216,485 B raw, 566 B reached the context, 99.7% saved (2026-11-02, 2.0.0-next.26, claude-haiku-5-5). ```text What are the top 10 stories on the Hacker News front page right now? Give title, points and domain for each. ``` The hook sends WebFetch to the sandbox, and the agent reads ten stories from the page. 35,087 B raw, 1,501 B reached the context, 95.7% saved (2026-11-02, 2.0.0-next.26, claude-haiku-5-5). The front page changes, so the raw size changes with each run. ### See the saving Run the stats skill right after a prompt. Each agent uses its own command; the skill calls `ctx_stats` and shows its report unchanged. | Agent | Command | |---|---| | Antigravity | `/ctx-stats` | | Claude Code | `/ctx-stats` | | Codex | `$ctx-stats` | | Copilot CLI | `/ctx-stats` | | Gemini CLI | `Call ctx_stats and show me the report.` | | Kiro | `Call ctx_stats and show me the report.` | | OMP | `/skill:ctx-stats` | | OpenCode | `Call ctx_stats and show me the report.` | | Pi | `/skill:ctx-stats` | | Qwen Code | `Call ctx_stats and show me the report.` | | VS Code (Copilot) | `/ctx-stats` | | ZCode | `Call ctx_stats and show me the report.` | The first lines of a real report, after the JSON prompt above ran as one `ctx_execute` call: ```text context-mode stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── This session · 1 call · <1m active 1015.5 KB became 3.7 KB: 1011.8 KB kept out (99.6%) Without context-mode |████████████████████████████████████████| 1015.5 KB With context-mode |█░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░| 3.7 KB about 259K tokens kept out, 1.3 times a 200K window ``` Captured 2026-11-03 with 2.0.0-next.35: `release-out/server.mjs` over MCP in a temp HOME. All 36 such rows, the six categories below: the plugin keeps a median of 99.4% of output bytes out of the context. Bench on 2.0.0-next.23 (commit 16a4bcc5 and the local edits that the file records), macOS arm64, 2026-11-01. | Category | What runs | Rows | Median saved | |---|---|---:|---:| | a. Sandbox | `ctx_execute` on a file or command | 19 | 99.5% | | b. Retrieval | `ctx_search` over the local index | 3 | 77.2% | | c. Batch | `ctx_batch`: many commands, then search | 2 | 93.1% | | d. The full file lists every row, small ones too: [2026-11-01-darwin-arm64.md](bench/results/2026-11-01-darwin-arm64.md). Reproduce with `cd bench && node run.mjs`. It needs plain Node and runs offline; [bench/README.md](bench/README.md) lists each scenario and its options. Method, data files and rerun steps: [Benchmarks guide](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/benchmarks?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=benchmarks). ### Longer sessions Say you debug a slow test all afternoon. The agent reads files, runs the suite and fetches docs, and each result goes into the context window. When the window is full, the host compacts it, and from then on the agent sees a short summary plus your next message. Context Mode keeps the full output of each large tool call in `context.db` on your machine and gives the agent a small reply. At compaction, a snapshot of at most 2,048 B keeps the session state. After the compaction, the agent calls `ctx_resume` to read that snapshot back and `ctx_search` to find any earlier output by keyword. In the bench, a scripted session of 40 tool outputs and one compaction made a 442,893 B transcript, and the `ctx_resume` block that brought the agent back was 2,019 B (row `e-long-session` in the bench file; [open the case](bench/e-continuity/README.md#e-long-session)). In the same bench, one large log of 666,796 B put 3,380 B into the context, and the full log stayed in the index for `ctx_search` (row `d-synth-1m`; [open the case](bench/d-externalize/README.md#d-synth-1m)). How the snapshot picks what to keep: the [Long sessions guide](https://contextmode.ai/docs/engine/long-sessions?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_content=longer-sessions) and [ADR-0009](docs/architecture/adr/0009-compaction-and-memory.md). ### Speed Median of 5 runs, bench of 2026-11-01. | Measure | Result | |---|---| | Hook time over a bare `node` start, per agent | 7.5 ms to 12.3 ms | | `ctx_search`, 20 queries over 8 indexed files | 1.62 ms median, 6.70 ms max | | `ctx_index`, 3 real files, 625,649 B | 150 ms per MB | Source: rows `g-hook-kiro` to `g-hook-claude-code`, `g-search-latency` and `g-index-per-mb` of [the bench file](bench/results/2026-11-01-darwin-arm64.md), with every agent and query. The [overhead cases](bench/g-overhead/README.md) show how each one runs. Next, what happens inside one tool call, in [How it works](#how-it-works). ## How it works One tool call, in time order, from the install to a hook error. 1. **Install.** Each agent's own install command adds the MCP server, the hooks and the skills `ctx-doctor`, `ctx-stats` and `ctx-upgrade` to that agent's config folder, for example `~/.codex/skills//SKILL.md`. `context-mode setup` writes or repairs any part the native command leaves out ([ADR-0023](docs/architecture/adr/ADR-0023-native-install.md)). 2. **Session start.** The `SessionStart` hook opens the project database. When the session ran before, the agent gets one line that tells it to call `ctx_resume` ([dispatch.ts](src/core/hooks/dispatch.ts)). 3. **PreToolUse checks.** Before a tool runs, the `PreToolUse` hook checks the call in a fixed order: the user's deny list, WebFetch, curl and wget, inline HTTP and build commands, then a full-file Read over `OUTPUT_CAP` (16,384 B) and one-file shell dumps such as `cat` or `tail`. A Read with a line range runs as usual ([decide.ts](src/core/policy/decide.ts)). 4. **The exact call.** When a check matches, the hook stops the call and its reply names the exact `ctx_*` call to use, for example `ctx_execute` with `{"language":"shell","code":"","intent":""}`. For WebFetch the reply names `ctx_index`, then `ctx_search` ([read-deny.ts](src/core/policy/read-deny.ts)). 5. **The sandbox.** This is the Code Mode step: the agent's script runs here, and only what it prints comes back. `ctx_execute` writes the script to a temp folder and spawns the runtime from an argument list in the project folder. The timeout is `EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS` (600,000 ms, default and maximum); on timeout it stops the whole process group (`taskkill /F /T` on Windows). The child gets your environment minus preload variables such as `NODE_OPTIONS`, and the agent gets what the script prints, at most `OUTPUT_CAP` ([execute.ts](src/core/tools/execute.ts)). **Code Mode.** The agent sends a short script as a tool parameter, the script reads the data in the sandbox, and only what it prints goes into the context. Two real calls, in the form the Claude Code terminal shows them: `ctx_execute` on 5,000 JSON records, from the Claude Code 2.1.312 stream of the Try-it run with Context Mode 2.0.0-next.26 ([04-api-json.json](bench/evidence/try-it-2026-11-02/04-api-json.json)). A Markdown chunk stays inside one heading section, and a code block that fits stays whole. Each chunk goes into two SQLite FTS5 tables: a Porter-stemmed table for words and a trigram table for paths, names and parts of words ([fts.ts](src/core/store/fts.ts)). `ctx_index` on a copy of this repo's `docs/how-it-works.md`, one live MCP call to `release-out/server.mjs` of Context Mode 2.0.0-next.36 on 2026-11-03 ([calls.json](bench/evidence/terminal-calls-2026-11-03/calls.json)).
